title: [UE-0.4d] Art dump script
body:

Day 0

### Owner role

Technical Director

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Art Director

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `tools/ue/art_dump.py`, `pipeline/art/style.json`, `pipeline/art/import-rules.md`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `tools/ue/art_dump.py`, `pipeline/art/style.json`, `pipeline/art/import-rules.md`
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.4a, UE-0.10b

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.6d, UE-0.10

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] The agent writes `tools/ue/art_dump.py` and the `style.json` lines, runs them from its outbox copy, and sends them as the card's gate patch
- [ ] Kickoff applies it itself through the tool checks (`python3 tools/git_gate.py apply UE-0.4d --auto`: every path in the card's lane, no guardrail enforcer changed, no guardrail file loosened; the PR has a `GATE EDIT: by=kickoff` line naming the patched paths)
- [ ] Every line of the "Card 0.4d done-when" block in `pipeline/art/import-rules.md` is met, with outputs pasted
- [ ] `python3 tools/sprite_check.py --import-report Saved/ArtDump.json` on the 5 anchors prints errors=0 (pasted)
- [ ] `grep -c VERIFY pipeline/art/import-rules.md` prints 0

### Budget and cut tier

120 min agent + 60 min human, MVP

none
